patterns.note: Content is presented in full-width sections with generous vertical padding, using a clean grid for image galleries and team member cards.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for impact, while body text is a lighter weight, creating a clear typographic hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette of white and dark grey is accented by a deep blue for informational sections and a vibrant green for calls to action and interactive elements.
A distinctive geometric grid overlay animates into view as the user scrolls, transitioning between major content blocks and adding a dynamic visual layer.
The header navigation bar shrinks in height and transforms its 'Contact' button from a ghost style to a filled style upon scrolling down the page.
The 'Team' section features a grid of individual profile cards, each with a circular image and clear role description, presented against a light blue background.

technique_notes: The sticky navigation bar is implemented to dynamically change its size and the styling of its primary call-to-action button after a certain scroll threshold, providing a compact persistent header.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely using GSAP or Locomotive Scroll, reveal content sections with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport. A unique geometric grid overlay animates across the screen to visually transition between distinct content areas, creating a sense of depth and dynamism.
Full-bleed hero images and background sections are used, with text content layered on top, ensuring visual impact while maintaining readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: large, impactful headings (~3-4x body) with a clean sans-serif character, supported by clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle for interactive elements like buttons, sharp for image corners and overall section boundaries.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with significant vertical spacing between major sections and a comfortable rhythm within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive geometric grid overlay animation, which acts as a dynamic visual transition between sections, elevates the user experience beyond a standard scroll-reveal. This, combined with the authoritative and clean presentation of complex technical information, makes the design feel sophisticated and unique.
